title: Constitutional Morality
lead: Adherence to the ==core principles, ethos and spirit== embedded in a nation's constitution, beyond mere legal compliance. Originating with British jurist ==George Grote==, it was brought into the Indian context by ==Dr B.R. Ambedkar== during the Constituent Assembly Debates — ==constitutional ethics over societal prejudice==.

items: ==Rule of law== — supremacy of law and equality before it
==Democratic governance== — participatory democracy and institutional accountability
==Fundamental rights protection== — safeguarding individuals against arbitrary state action
==Social justice and equality== — addressing historical discrimination, promoting ==substantive equality==
==Judicial integrity and independence== — impartial courts free of political influence

head: Case
Holding
rows: [[Naz Foundation v. Govt of NCT of Delhi (2009)]]
Invoked constitutional morality to strike down ==s.377 IPC== — protecting minority rights ==irrespective of societal morality==.
Reaffirmed constitutional morality, overturning ==Koushal (2013)== — ==dignity, liberty and equality== of the LGBTQ+ community.
[[Indian Young Lawyers Association v. State of Kerala (2018)]] — Sabarimala
==Constitutional morality over popular sentiment== — allowed entry of women, upholding gender equality.
Decriminalised adultery, stressing ==gender equality and individual autonomy==.
Upheld ==privacy as a fundamental right==, invoking constitutional morality to protect autonomy and dignity.

items.title: Criticisms & Challenges
bullets: ==Ambiguity and judicial subjectivity== — an open-ended concept risking ==judicial overreach==
==Conflict with popular morality== — implementation falters where constitutional morality opposes societal belief, as in ==Sabarimala==, causing societal and political resistance

items.title: Significance & Impact
bullets: Reinforces India's commitment to ==transformative constitutionalism==, promoting social reform and justice
Fosters ==inclusive democracy== by prioritising constitutional ethics over ==majoritarian impulses==
Encourages progressive attitudes, ==protecting minorities and marginalised communities==

items: ==Clear judicial articulation and consistent application== to mitigate ambiguity
==Broader societal education and dialogue== to align societal values with constitutional ideals
==Strengthen institutional frameworks== to operationalise constitutional morality effectively

blocks.text: Constitutional morality acts as a compass guiding democratic governance towards justice, liberty and equality. Its significance lies in transcending transient societal prejudices to uphold enduring constitutional values.
